# ARC GitHub Action docs

Start with `quickstart.md` for the fastest path, then use `install.md` for the detailed reference.

Files in this folder:

- `quickstart.md`: 10-minute install and proof path.
- `install.md`: detailed V1 install reference.
- `arc-pr-check.workflow.yml`: workflow example used by the manual proof repo.
- `example-plan.aiplan`: minimal frozen plan example with test files included in allowed scope.
